component.name: HexGlitcher
component.summary: Layered, realtime image and video databender

description.p: HexGlitcher is a non-destructive, layered, realtime glitch-art studio for images and video. Corrupt raw bytes, sort pixels, glitch video frame-by-frame, and watch it happen live.

ul.li: Non-destructive compositing layers with blend modes and opacity
A stacked pipeline of 22 byte- and pixel-domain glitch operations
Realtime preview on a background thread
Per-frame video glitching with MP4 export
One-click Looks, a Surprise button, and re-editable .glitch projects

description.p: Ground-up PySide6 rewrite: layers, realtime preview, 22 ops, video glitching.
